summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of CipherBox — adding cryptographic IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust (crates/core, crates/fuse) and TypeScript (sdk-core, web) with TDD discipline and all decision gates D-01..D-13.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves) and executed: all plans complete, cargo/jest/SDK-E2E gates passed (core 75, fuse 87, api jest 913/913, SDK E2E 89/89), phase verification passed 7/7 must-haves, VERIFICATION.md written, and advisory code-review findings queued for application.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client or core due to dependency cycles — cross-language verify vectors must live in crates/fuse/tests/ not crates/crypto/tests/

TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only' but the SDK E2E harness defaults to 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' — they don't match; the gate silently skips if wrong secret is used
D-09 sequence-validation tightening historically broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests; this class of change requires explicit E2E gate confirmation before phase sign-off
The D-09 idempotent path (same sequence, update latestCid, no increment) is intentional and must not be removed
replay.rs uses unchecked seq + 1 arithmetic while the rest of the crate uses checked_add — inconsistency flagged as WR-01 in code review
9 FUSE resolve sites needed routing through resolve_ipns_verified; 1 folder-key descent site intentionally kept as hard-fail (not routed)
Local dev stack topology: redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo — all must be running for SDK E2E gate

code.finding: New file — resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint wrapper; ciborium dep must be in crates/fuse/Cargo.toml (not just crates/core) for this to compile
expectedSequenceNumber guard at line 245 is the CAS 409 conflict check — intentionally left unchanged by D-09 work, not a D-09 regression

workflow: Sequential executor on the feature branch is the correct mode for security/crypto phases where parallel-worktree merge failures would be catastrophic
commit_failed from the GSD commit helper is a known false negative — always verify with git log before retrying
Plan checker cosmetic warnings (missing RESOLVED marker on Open Questions) are cheaper to fix by direct file edit than by re-running the planner
When an executor dies mid-task via socket error, assess git log + uncommitted diff before spawning a continuation — partial work is often committed and only the tail needs redoing
Phase verifier and code reviewer can be spawned in parallel after all plans complete — they are fully independent
An executor may overrun its scoped plan and continue into the next sequential plan in the same run; treat resulting commits as valid but adjust wave checkpoint accounting

friction: 58-01 executor hit an API socket error mid-execution, dropping ~40% of the plan uncommitted and requiring a manual continuation agent
SDK E2E gate silently produced 0 results (skipped) due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch between API .env and SDK E2E harness default — looked like a pass until investigated
58-02 executor scope-crept into 58-03 in the same run without being asked, requiring post-hoc wave checkpoint reconciliation
ciborium-not-a-fuse-dep diagnostic from the crashed executor was stale (the dep was already added) — caused unnecessary alarm during recovery assessment
commit_failed false negative after writing VALIDATION.md required an extra git log verification step
open_items: Code review findings (WR-01: unchecked seq+1 in replay.rs; plus 3 robustness/parity items) sent to code-fixer agent — transcript ends before confirmation they were applied and tests re-run
TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch between apps/api/.env and SDK E2E harness should be documented or normalized so the gate cannot silently skip in future phases
58-02 full-SDK-E2E gate was infra-limited during plan execution and only ran correctly via a separate gate agent — the executor-level E2E gate setup needs the secret alignment fix to be reliable
